# Pinned Python environment for local inference, with hashes.
#
# Regenerate after changing mlxLMVersion or mlxVersion in runtime.go:
#
#   printf 'mlx-lm==<v>\nmlx==<v>\n' > /tmp/mlx-req.in
#   uv pip compile /tmp/mlx-req.in --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 \
#       -o cli/nav-pilot/internal/local/requirements.txt
#
# Why this file exists: pinning only mlx-lm and mlx left every transitive
# dependency resolving to whatever was newest on install day, unhashed. That is
# one unpinned link in an otherwise pinned chain, and it runs inside the process
# that reads a developer's repository. With --require-hashes, an install either
# matches these bytes or fails.
#
# macOS arm64 on CPython 3.12, which is the only platform `alpha local init`
# accepts.
